plaatsen.tekst: (For he had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For oftentimes it had caught him: and he was kept bound with chains and in fetters; and he brake the bands, and was driven of the devil into the wilderness.)
And they stirred up the people, and the elders, and the scribes, and came upon him, and caught him, and brought him to the council,
And the whole city was filled with confusion: and having caught Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul's companions in travel, they rushed with one accord into the theatre.
And when the ship was caught, and could not bear up into the wind, we let her drive.
